description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'Compare' with multiple nested classes implementing various comparison operations (e.g., equals, greater, less, is-null). It provides a factory method to obtain comparison instances based on operator strings and includes methods for performing comparisons with type conversions.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: Abstract class implementing comparison logic with various operators and nested classes for specific comparison types.

classes.name: CompareContains
classes.description: Checks if a collection contains a value or if a string contains a substring.

classes.name: CompareEquals
classes.description: Checks if two values are equal after type conversion.

classes.name: CompareGreater
classes.description: Checks if one value is greater than another after type conversion.

classes.name: CompareGreaterEquals
classes.description: Checks if one value is greater than or equal to another after type conversion.

classes.name: CompareIsEmpty
classes.description: Checks if a value is empty.

classes.name: CompareIsNotNull
classes.description: Checks if a value is not null.

classes.name: CompareIsNull
classes.description: Checks if a value is null.

classes.name: CompareLess
classes.description: Checks if one value is less than another after type conversion.

classes.name: CompareLessEquals
classes.description: Checks if one value is less than or equal to another after type conversion.

classes.name: CompareNotEquals
classes.description: Checks if two values are not equal after type conversion.

methods.name: assertValuesNotNull
methods.description: Ensures that both values are not null before comparison.

methods.name: createInstanceMap
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable map of operator strings to comparison instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a Compare instance based on the operator string.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the comparison, implemented by subclasses.
